benchmarks.name: AA Text to Image Arena
benchmarks.caveat: Blind pairwise votes on images from the same prompt, collected by Artificial Analysis and reported as an Elo with a confidence interval. One publisher with several arenas: one independent voice.

benchmarks.name: Arena Text-to-Image
benchmarks.caveat: Blind pairwise votes on images from the same prompt. Measures what people prefer to look at; a model marked Preliminary has few votes yet and a wide error bar.

benchmarks.name: Arena Image Edit
benchmarks.caveat: Blind pairwise votes on edits of the same source image under the same instruction. Preliminary marks a model with few votes yet.

excluded.name: SWE-bench Verified
excluded.reason: Read on 2026-09-05: the newest of its 181 entries is dated 2026-02-17. None of the models above appear on it. Including a stale board would add a column of blanks, not a signal.

excluded.name: LiteLLM — Jev vs Haiku 4.5 on request classification
excluded.reason: Read on 2026-09-22: a careful independent test — 80 authored cases, three runs, frozen results and reproduction scripts — but it compares exactly two models. This index drops any measure with fewer than three, because standardizing a pair places the loser at 35 and the winner at 65 whether they differ by two points or thirty. The figures are worth reading at the source; they are not worth a number here.

catalogs.name: OpenRouter
catalogs.caveat: Used as a catalog of where a model can be called and on what terms, not as a source of scores. Prices and availability are the router’s at the date read and move often. Listing here is not an endorsement of the router over the vendor’s own API.

catalogs.name: Hugging Face
catalogs.caveat: Parameter counts are read from the weights files of the model’s repository (safetensors metadata). Only open-weight models have one; a closed model’s size is undisclosed, not estimated.
